title: Sprint 规划词汇
html:
Sprint 规划词汇

概述

本章聚焦 Sprint 规划环节，分为规划核心词汇、估算与优先级、Sprint 目标与范围、工具与看板四个部分。它提供迭代规划中常用的英语词汇，覆盖从确定目标到估算工作量再到排期的过程。每个部分配有听说例句与写作表达，适合规划会议和团队文档。建议把规划核心词汇与估算、优先级术语结合学习，理解迭代规划的判断依据。

规划核心词汇

词汇 词性 含义 常用搭配
sprint planning n. 冲刺规划 sprint planning meeting, planning session
capacity n. 产能 team capacity, capacity planning
story point n. 故事点 estimate story points, story point velocity
commitment n. 承诺 sprint commitment, team commitment
grooming n. 梳理 backlog grooming, grooming session
epic n. 史诗/大需求 create an epic, epic breakdown

听说例句

A: What's our team capacity for the next sprint? B: We have 40 story points of capacity after accounting for PTO and on-call duties.

A: Should we groom the backlog before sprint planning? B: Yes, let's break down the epics into smaller stories so we can estimate accurately.

写作表达

  • Sprint planning begins with a review of team capacity and a commitment to a realistic set of deliverables.
  • Regular backlog grooming ensures that stories are well-defined and ready for estimation during planning.

估算与优先级

词汇 词性 含义 常用搭配
estimate v./n. 估算 effort estimate, estimate in points
poker (planning poker) n. 规划扑克 play planning poker, poker session
t-shirt sizing n. T恤尺寸估算 use t-shirt sizing, S/M/L/XL
MoSCoW n. 优先级方法 Must/Should/Could/Won't, MoSCoW method
dependency n. 依赖 identify dependencies, dependency chain
risk n. 风险 assess risk, risk mitigation

听说例句

A: Let's use planning poker to estimate this story. B: I'd say it's an 8. There's a dependency on the auth service and some risk around the migration.

A: How should we prioritize the features? B: Let's apply the MoSCoW method. The login fix is a Must, the dashboard redesign is a Should.

写作表达

  • Planning poker fosters team consensus on effort estimation and surfaces hidden complexity early.
  • The MoSCoW prioritization method provides a clear framework for distinguishing critical requirements from nice-to-haves.

Sprint 目标与范围

词汇 词性 含义 常用搭配
sprint goal n. 冲刺目标 define sprint goal, align on goal
scope n. 范围 sprint scope, manage scope
stretch goal n. 拉伸目标 add as stretch goal, optional stretch
carry-over n. 遗留项 carry-over from last sprint, reduce carry-over
buffer n. 缓冲 add buffer, capacity buffer
commitment n. 承诺 team commitment, commitment vs forecast

听说例句

A: What's the sprint goal for this cycle? B: Ship the new onboarding flow. The analytics dashboard is a stretch goal if we have capacity.

A: We have three carry-over items from last sprint. B: Let's prioritize those first and add a 10% buffer to avoid overcommitting.

写作表达

  • A clearly defined sprint goal provides focus and enables the team to make trade-off decisions during execution.
  • Tracking carry-over items helps identify patterns of overcommitment and informs future capacity planning.

工具与看板

词汇 词性 含义 常用搭配
Kanban n. 看板 Kanban board, Kanban workflow
Jira n. Jira项目管理 create a Jira ticket, Jira board
WIP limit n. 在制品限制 set WIP limit, enforce WIP limit
swimlane n. 泳道 add a swimlane, swimlane by team
ticket n. 工单 create a ticket, move ticket
board n. 看板 sprint board, task board

听说例句

A: Should we set a WIP limit on the "In Review" column? B: Yes, limit it to 3 tickets. That will prevent bottlenecks and keep the flow moving.

A: Can you organize the Kanban board by swimlane? B: Sure, I'll add swimlanes for frontend, backend, and design so we can track each stream.

写作表达

  • Enforcing WIP limits on the Kanban board prevents multitasking overhead and improves flow efficiency.
  • Swimlanes provide visual clarity by grouping tickets by team or workstream on the sprint board.
